 Arthur fit again with five matches before Santos contract ends 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Arthur has recovered from a grade two injury to his right hamstring and could be included by coach Cuca for the match against Red Bull Bragantino on Monday.
 According to Globo.com, he sustained the problem earlier in October and is back inside four weeks, the minimum for this type of issue. With his deal up in December, he now has five games to impress.
 OneFootball Videos
 There had been concern over his fitness because of recurrent injuries, but the club is pleased with his recovery and with what he had shown in his appearances.
 Signed at the end of August after leaving Juventus, he had been starting and is expected to regain that role, though not against Red Bull Bragantino. He may be named in the squad, with around 30 minutes, most likely after the interval.
 Arthur is among Santos ' priorities for next season. Presidential elections on 14 December mean his future is set to be discussed towards the end of the campaign.
 Since arriving, he has played six matches and provided one assist. After Red Bull Bragantino, Santos face Coritiba away, Grêmio at home, Vitória away and Botafogo at home. They are eighth on 47 points, seven behind fifth-placed Athletico-PR.
 Source: Globo.com
